newsitem.title: UK: Goldman Sachs had approach from Galileo on CWS.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs had approach from Galileo on CWS.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs said on Friday it had been approached to participate in a controversial deal put together by entrepreneur Andrew Regan and his company Galileo to takeover the Co-operative Wholesale Society.
"Goldman Sachs was represented at a presentation given by Hambros (investment bank advisers to Galileo) and Galileo in late March," a spokesman told Reuters.

"We decided immediately and made clear to the other parties within days that we were not interested in proposals put forward in respect of CWS. Documents received were handed back to Hambros immediately when they were requested," the spokesman added.
He confirmed that the documents were sent back after a court injunction had been granted to CWS which demanded their return.
Goldman was responding to enquiries after it was named in the High Court on Friday, along with many other City financial institutions, as having received confidential documents concerning CWS.
